p.i: tas, ad expiationem urbis à sanguine occisi ex mandato Legis Mosaicæ. Quando inventum fuerit, in terra quam Dominus Deus daturus est tibi hominis cadaver occisi, & ignorabitur cædis reus; egredientur majores natu, & Iudices tui, & metientur à loco cadaveris singularum per circuitum spatia civitatum, & quam viciniorem ceteris esse perspexerint, Seniores civitatis illius tollent vitulam de armento, quæ non traxit jugum, nec terram scidit vomere, & ducent ea ad vallem asperam atque saxosam, quæ nunquam arata est, nec sementem accepit, & cadent in ea cervices vitulæ, accedentque Sacerdotes filii Levi (quos elegerit Dominus Deus, ut ministrent ei, & benedicant in nomine ejus) & ad verbum eorum omne negotium pendeat, & quicquid mundum vel immundum est, judicatur, & venient majores natu civitatis illius ad interfectum, levabuntq; manus suas super vitulam quæ in valle percussa est, & dicent, manus nostræ non effuderunt sanguinem hunc, nec oculi viderunt: propitius esto populo tuo Israel, quem redemisti (Domine) & ne reputes sanguinem innocentem in

page.notes: The strip at the far left belongs to the neighbouring page and is left out. The passage appears to be set in italic from its first word to the last, apart from the parentheses; the italic marking was judged from the scan and may be incomplete in places. The catchword "medio" is printed at the right foot and is kept out of the text. Printed forms such as "levabuntq;", "ejus" and "Iudices" are copied as they appear.
